# Vendored front-end libraries

Bundled locally so the site works without internet access or a CDN. Upgrade by replacing the files.

| Library | Version | License | Files |
|---------|---------|---------|-------|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | MIT | `bootstrap/` |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | MIT | `bootstrap-icons/` |
| Chart.js | 4.4.4 | MIT | `chartjs/` |
| FullCalendar | 6.1.15 | MIT | `fullcalendar/` |

Google Fonts is the only remaining external resource; without internet the site falls back to the
system font automatically.
